sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 文本单轮＋完整属性附件（仅暂缺项除外）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: T1所用独立模型为M-INT-086（L形缺角框架外缘偏置水平力）。T1完整给M-INT-086所有实际节点梁柱和楼面边界，注明东北角区不存在，直接分析。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 不能补齐缺失角区与虚构楼面；荷载分量的独立状态保持
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz；所有值附位置、方向、单位、工况及当前轮次；澄清前不编造数值。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 不补成矩形楼面或新增角柱；只在实际区域分配荷载；结果对象对应真实杆件；外缘12kN保持，不能补齐缺角以追求对称。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 不规则楼面荷载映射需验证；不规则楼面映射需验证；逐轮状态与目标/非目标差异评测待实现
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 底及两层基网格X=0/6/12m、Y=0/5/10m，z=0/3.6/7.2m；删除东北单元区域X=6～12/Y=5～10及孤立角点(12,10)，以剩余三格并集的实际梁柱为准。
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 所有柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 2乘2网格删去一个角部单元区域，两层3.6m，全部实际梁柱按表给出；二层外缘节点(x=12,y=0,z=7.2)m另施加Y正向12kN，缺失角区仍无梁柱楼面；每个实际楼面梁全局Z负向6kN/m，所有不存在角区不加载；另有屋面外缘12kN侧力。
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 各构件组完整A/Iy/Iz/J/G及E、nu记录；按本题附表逐字段给单位，不用模型默认值
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭；不自动施加刚性楼板/刚域、默认附加载或自动规范组合；严格保留题定约束、材料/截面完整属性、局部轴、荷载坐标与长度基准；单位逐字段明确。 保留三维六自由度/轴力单元各自约束和题定局部轴；各轮只执行明确修改，未被修改的字段保持；澄清内容按该轮生效。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 软件指定题，必须实际调用YJK完成每个可计算模型状态并取得当次结果；禁止用OpenSees结果冒充。仅显示设置/启动窗口不算完成；纯查询或单位变更可复用与未变模型一致的已验证结果。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 逐轮输入与澄清记录、模型状态快照及前后字段差异；变更目标与未变字段核对；原始求解输入/工程、软件版本/设置、运行ID和成功日志、原始结果到节点/构件/工况的映射；结果绑定当前模型状态。核对目标：最高层最右且Y最大梁柱节点Ux/Uz/Uy及最左首层柱底My/Rz。 保存YJK原生工程及可复查模型导出/参数检查记录；模型改变后的新run须绑定更新后的工程，截屏只作辅助。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 当前完整笛卡尔网格会拒绝L形缺角；须支持非矩形楼层拓扑、实际梁线载和偏置水平节点力；现接口对关闭自重、无刚性楼板及完整弹性/截面属性的逐字段映射未证明，须显式设置并核验，禁止静默采用软件默认。节点反力虽有抽取路径，仍须验证本题节点/楼层ID对应与符号。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 每个可计算轮次由独立复核者在YJK创建参考模型并保存状态；模型改变后独立新算，纯结果查询沿用有效状态；核对力/矩平衡及适用解析结果，可用同假设OpenSees交叉校核；差异先追溯荷载分配/支座/轴向/楼板设置，不直接强求跨软件逐值相等。

turns.instruction:
Analyze the complete attached L-shaped frame directly in YJK. The northeast corner region is intentionally absent. Use only the supplied real nodes, columns, beams and floor boundaries. Preserve the single eccentric +Y force of 12 kN and all actual-beam gravity loads. Report Ux, Uz and Uy at n2-1-2, and global support My and Rz=Fz at n0-0-0.
Use the stated YJK engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable run ID. Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

acceptanceGates.description: Execute the named engine independently for each changed computable state and each selection; retain software version, settings, native input, run ID, successful log and raw result mapping.
Generate and independently review same-engine reference values; check equilibrium, signs, units and stiffness without importing the SUT path.
Independently reconstruct each turn from only its released public input and verify original source requirements.
Verify target field changes, all non-target fields, undo equivalence and query-only state identity.
Exercise this case topology, loads, coordinates and selected engine; support in principle is not evidence of adapter acceptance.
Check signed quantities in the report body, locations, directions, units, selections and current turn against structured artifacts.

authoringNotes: section-diversity-v1: author-completed section linear dimensions scaled by 108/100; A and explicit shear areas scale quadratically, Iy/Iz/J quartically. Source geometry, loads, materials, axes, section ratios and turn schedule retained. Public section numbers use eight significant digits; unchanged historical results do not apply.
